pub type Raw
pub enum AcceptanceOutcome
  Accepted
  DefinitelyNotAccepted
  Unknown
  KeyConflict
  Forbidden
  Invalid
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum CancellationOutcome
  Requested
  AlreadyTerminal
  Unknown
  Forbidden
  Unsupported
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 6]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum WorkState
  Pending
  Running
  Transferred
  Complete
  Failed
  Cancelled
  pub const ALL: [Self; 6]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum FailureClass
  Retryable
  Permanent
  Unknown
  pub const ALL: [Self; 3]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub mod failure_cause
  pub const OTHER: &str
  pub const DIGEST_MISMATCH: &str
  pub const OVERSIZE: &str
  pub const SHORT_TRANSFER: &str
  pub const UNAUTHORIZED: &str
  pub const NOT_FOUND: &str
  pub const REFUSED: &str
  pub const SERVER_ERROR: &str
  pub const TRANSPORT: &str
  pub const RESULT_LOST: &str
  pub const CREDENTIAL: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 11]
pub enum ObservationOutcome
  Observed
  Unknown
  Forbidden
  Invalid
  DefinitelyNotAccepted
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 6]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum ResultOutcome
  Data
  NotReady
  Unavailable
  Unsupported
  Unknown
  Forbidden
  Invalid
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum InventoryOutcome
  Page
  Gap
  Forbidden
  Invalid
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 5]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum OperatorCancellationOutcome
  Requested
  AlreadyTerminal
  Unknown
  Forbidden
  Invalid
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 6]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub mod service_error_code
  pub const HANDLER_ERROR: &str
  pub const INVALID_RESULT: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_VERSION: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_SERVICE: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_METHOD: &str
  pub const WRONG_MODE: &str
  pub const FORBIDDEN: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 7]
pub const ADMISSION_GUARANTEES: [&str; 3]
pub const ACCEPTANCE_ERROR_CODES: [&str; 1]
pub const RESOURCE_ACTIONS: [&str; 3]
pub struct RequestIdentity
  key: String
  history_epoch: String
  attempt: i64
pub struct Submission
  identity: RequestIdentity
  kind: String
  spec: Vec<u8>
  required_guarantees: Vec<String>
  label: String
pub struct Receipt
  identity: RequestIdentity
  logical_owner: String
  operation_id: String
  accepted_guarantees: Vec<String>
  history_retention_ms: i64
pub struct AcceptanceResult
  outcome: AcceptanceOutcome
  receipt: Option<Receipt>
  reason: String
pub struct HistoryWindow
  logical_owner: String
  history_epoch: String
  minimum_retention_ms: i64
  result_retention_ms: i64
pub struct CancellationResult
  outcome: CancellationOutcome
pub struct WorkProgress
  done: i64
  total: i64
pub struct WorkFailure
  classification: FailureClass
  message: String
  cause: String
pub struct OperationSnapshot
  receipt: Receipt
  state: WorkState
  progress: WorkProgress
  cancellation_requested: bool
  failure: Option<WorkFailure>
  label: String
  label_derived: bool
  waiting: String
pub struct ObservationResult
  outcome: ObservationOutcome
  snapshot: Option<OperationSnapshot>
pub struct ResultChunk
  receipt: Receipt
  offset: i64
  total: i64
  data: Vec<u8>
  eof: bool
pub struct ResultRead
  outcome: ResultOutcome
  chunk: Option<ResultChunk>
pub struct InventoryPage
  outcome: InventoryOutcome
  snapshots: Vec<OperationSnapshot>
  next: String
  complete: bool
pub struct OperatorCancellation
  outcome: OperatorCancellationOutcome
pub fn encode(v: &AcceptanceResult) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<AcceptanceResult, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait RecoverableAcceptance
  type Error
  fn get_history_window(&self) -> Result<HistoryWindow, Self::Error>
  fn submit(&self, submission: Submission) -> Result<AcceptanceResult, Self::Error>
  fn reconcile(&self, identity: RequestIdentity) -> Result<AcceptanceResult, Self::Error>
  fn cancel_work(&self, identity: RequestIdentity) -> Result<CancellationResult, Self::Error>
pub struct RecoverableAcceptanceClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait OperationControl
  type Error
  fn observe_work(&self, identity: RequestIdentity) -> Result<ObservationResult, Self::Error>
  fn read_result(&self, identity: RequestIdentity, offset: i64, max_bytes: i64) -> Result<ResultRead, Self::Error>
pub struct OperationControlClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait JobInventory
  type Error
  fn list_work(&self, cursor: String, limit: i64) -> Result<InventoryPage, Self::Error>
pub struct JobInventoryClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait JobOperator
  type Error
  fn list_account_work(&self, cursor: String, limit: i64) -> Result<InventoryPage, Self::Error>
  fn cancel_operation(&self, operation_id: String) -> Result<OperatorCancellation, Self::Error>
pub struct JobOperatorClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
